title: ADR-014: Redis Streams for the matchmaking ticket queue
storage:
Status: Accepted · Date: 2025-09-03 · Owners: Matchmaking squad

Context

Matchmaking tickets arrive at ~40k/s at peak across 6 regions. Tickets live for seconds, need per-region ordering and must be re-claimable when a matcher pod dies.

Decision

Matchmaking tickets are enqueued and consumed through Redis Streams with one consumer group per region. We will not run Kafka or RabbitMQ for matchmaking traffic.

Alternatives considered

  • Kafka: rejected. Consumer rebalances add multi-second stalls during deploys, and we would need a dedicated platform owner.
  • RabbitMQ: rejected, no replay and poor behaviour under queue buildup.
  • Amazon SQS FIFO: rejected because of per-group throughput limits.

Consequences

This ADR only covers matchmaking. Analytics pipelines keep using Kinesis.

title: ADR-017: Keycloak as the player identity provider
storage:
Status: Accepted · Deciders: Accounts team, Security

Context

We have 8M MAU across PC, console and mobile, and data residency requirements in KR and JP.

Decision

All player login, token issuance and token refresh must go through our self-hosted Keycloak realm. Platform logins (Steam, PSN, Xbox, Apple, Google) are federated into Keycloak as identity providers; game services never verify platform tickets themselves, they only accept Keycloak-issued tokens.

Rejected options

  • Auth0: per-MAU pricing is prohibitive at our scale.
  • Firebase Authentication: no KR/JP data residency guarantee, weak console support.

title: ADR-027: ScyllaDB for leaderboards (supersedes ADR-011)
storage:
Status: Accepted · Supersedes: ADR-011

Context

The global board on DynamoDB hit hot-partition throttling every season reset.

Decision

Seasonal, event and all-time leaderboards are persisted in ScyllaDB. Top-N reads are served from a Redis sorted-set cache rebuilt from Scylla.

Alternatives

  • Stay on DynamoDB: rejected, see context.
  • Apache Cassandra: rejected, JVM GC pauses and higher ops load for the same data model.
  • MongoDB: rejected, sorted range queries at this cardinality were 5x slower in the benchmark.

title: ADR-011: DynamoDB for leaderboards
storage:
Status: Superseded by ADR-027 (2026-03-09)

Decision

Leaderboards are stored in DynamoDB with one GSI per season, ranked by score.

Notes

Kept for history. Do not use for new work.

title: ADR-031: Agones for dedicated game server orchestration
storage:
Status: Proposed · under review, not yet accepted · Author: Game server infra

Context

Fleet scaling on the current GameLift setup is slow and expensive for our session lengths.

Proposed decision

Run dedicated game servers on GKE with Agones fleets and autoscalers instead of Amazon GameLift. Unity Multiplay was also evaluated and is not recommended.

Open questions

  • Cross-cloud latency to Kinesis analytics.
  • Migration window for the current GameLift fleets.

title: Store & Payments Policy: purchase entitlement
storage:
Scope

Applies to every surface that sells premium currency, items, bundles or battle passes: mobile, Steam, console and the Xsolla web shop.

Policy

Before any premium currency, item or battle pass entitlement is granted, the store receipt must be validated server-side by payments-service against the issuing platform. A purchase-success signal from the game client is never sufficient on its own to grant anything.

Rationale

In 2024 a patched client faked Google Play callbacks and minted ~2.1M gems before detection.

title: Trust & Safety: bulk enforcement approval
storage:
Rule

Any bulk enforcement action — a ban wave, a mass currency or item rollback, or a suspension touching more than 50 accounts in one operation — requires written sign-off from the Trust & Safety lead in #ts-approvals before it is executed.

Out of scope

  • Single-account actions taken by on-call moderators.
  • Temporary (24h) automated kicks issued by the live anti-cheat signature pipeline.

Why

The March 2025 false-positive wave banned 11k legitimate players and took a week to reverse.

title: Live Ops sync — 2026-06-12
storage:
Attendees: Live ops, backend on-call, community, QA

Discussion

  • Two weekend incidents in May traced to event config pushed Saturday with nobody from backend online.
  • Community team wants more lead time for announcements.
  • QA asked for a staging soak of at least one day for drop-rate changes (not agreed, revisit).

Outcome

  • Decision: No live-event configuration changes (drop rates, event schedules, store rotations, reward tables) go out between Friday 18:00 and Monday 10:00 KST. The only exception is rolling back a change that is already broken.

Action items

  • Minji: add the freeze window to the live-ops calendar.
  • Tom: block the config-push job during the window.

title: 채팅 데이터 보관 원칙
storage:
배경

개인정보 보호 검토 결과 채팅 원문 장기 보관은 위험 요소로 지적되었다.

원칙

채팅 메시지 원문은 최대 30일까지만 보관한다. 30일이 지난 원문은 DB, 캐시, 백업, 아카이브 어디에도 남기지 않고 자동 삭제한다.

예외

  • 신고된 메시지와 그 앞뒤 20개 메시지는 T&S 조사가 종료될 때까지 별도 보관할 수 있다.
  • 원문이 포함되지 않은 집계 지표(메시지 수, 금칙어 탐지 횟수 등)는 보관 기간 제한이 없다.

title: 확률형 아이템 운영 규칙
storage:
목적

확률형 아이템 정보 공개 의무를 지키고 이용자 신뢰를 유지한다.

규칙

확률형 아이템(가챠, 상자, 뽑기)의 확률 테이블이나 보상 풀을 변경하는 배포는 게임 내 공지와 공식 홈페이지 확률 공개 페이지 갱신이 먼저 완료된 뒤에만 나갈 수 있다. 사전 공지 없이 확률을 바꾸는 배포는 핫픽스라도 허용하지 않는다.

담당

공지 확인은 라이브 운영 PM, 배포는 store-service 담당.

title: 백엔드 주간회의 회의록 (2026-04-08)
storage:
참석: 백엔드 리드, 그로스팀, 플랫폼팀

논의

  • 그로스팀이 세그먼트 기반 마케팅 푸시 툴을 요청함.
  • 현재 iOS는 APNs 직접 발송, Android는 FCM으로 이원화되어 장애 대응이 번거로움.

결정 사항

  • 결정: 모바일 푸시 알림은 FCM(Firebase Cloud Messaging)으로 일원화한다. iOS도 FCM을 거쳐 APNs로 보낸다. OneSignal, Airship은 도입하지 않는다.

액션 아이템

  • 지훈: iOS 직접 발송 경로를 FCM으로 마이그레이션 (Q2)

title: Engineering Handbook — Logging & Telemetry
storage:
Purpose

How backend services write logs, crash dumps and analytics events.

원칙 (Principle)

Player PII — email address, phone number, real name, IP address, payment card fragments — is never written to game-server logs, crash dumps or analytics events. Reference players by the hashed player_id only.

Exception

fraud-service may persist IP addresses in its encrypted fraud_signals table. This is a datastore, not a log, and is covered by the fraud retention policy.

Log levels

Use INFO for state transitions, DEBUG is disabled in production.

title: Matchmaking Guideline: rating formula changes
storage:
Background

Season 9 shipped a new MMR decay formula directly and inflated Diamond+ by 40% in a week.

규칙 (Guideline)

Changes to the MMR / rating formula (including K-factor, decay, placement weighting and uncertainty parameters) reach production only via shadow mode: the new formula runs alongside the live one for at least 7 days, and the competitive design lead reviews the diff report before it becomes authoritative.

title: ADR-021: Easy Anti-Cheat for client integrity
storage:
Status: Accepted

Decision

PC client integrity protection uses Easy Anti-Cheat. We do not build or ship our own kernel-mode anti-cheat component.

Alternatives considered

  • BattlEye: rejected, licensing terms did not cover our console cross-play setup.
  • In-house kernel driver: rejected, security liability and driver-signing burden for a team of our size.
  • Vanguard-style always-on driver: rejected for the same reasons.

Consequences

Server-side detection (statistics, replay analysis) remains in-house.

title: API Gateway Standard
storage:
Standard

Every public-facing HTTP or WebSocket endpoint needs a rate-limit policy configured in the Kong gateway before it is exposed to the internet. The default is 20 req/s per player; higher limits need platform team approval.

Notes

Cluster-internal gRPC between services does not go through Kong and is not covered.
